title: Extend draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 with mimid's client surface
description: Decision (Mark, 2026-10-18; recorded as kaiwa-g2v5.13): the draft gains the client-facing surface mimid already plans (mimid-1wgh.12, approved 2026-10-17): a urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi capability; KeyPackage, KeyMaterial/fetch, Room/create, Room/update, GroupInfo/fetch methods; Chat.roomId; MLS-ciphertext body types application/mimi-content and application/mimi-fanout. Today the draft is gateway conversion rules only and defines no client surface. Read mimid-1wgh.12 in ~/PROJECT/mimid/.beads for the planned shapes; keep the existing gateway rules. Consumers: mimid's JMAP endpoint; kaiwa's later E2EE layer (kaiwa-g2v5.17). Drafting needs Mark (he owns the text).
close_reason: Edits reviewed and decided by Mark 2026-10-18; committed in spec(chat) resolve gaps / mimi client surface.
